garage.note: British English usually stresses the first syllable; American English the second.

senses.definition: A building where a car is kept, usually next to or part of a house.
examples: The bikes are in the garage behind the house.
We converted the garage into a small office.

senses.definition: A business that repairs or sells cars and often sells fuel.
examples: The garage said the gearbox needs replacing.
Stop at the garage on the corner and fill up.

senses.definition: Real and exactly what it appears to be; not fake.
examples: The certificate turned out to be genuine after all.
These are genuine leather, not a substitute.
She showed genuine concern for the family.
There was genuine surprise on his face.
